description: This file contains a class 'AppIdentityDbContextSeed' responsible for seeding initial data into the identity database, including roles and default users, for the eShopOnWeb application infrastructure.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: A static class providing a method to seed default roles and users into the identity database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the identity database with default roles and users, creating an administrator role, a demo user, and an admin user with appropriate roles.
